questions.quesText: Which data structure operates on a Last-In First-Out (LIFO) access principle?
questions.explanation: A stack is a linear data structure following the Last-In First-Out (LIFO) principle, where push and pop operations occur at the top.

questions.quesText: The worst-case time complexity of standard Quicksort algorithm is ____.
questions.explanation: Quicksort degrades to O(n^2) when poor pivot elements are chosen (such as an already sorted array with the first or last element as pivot).

questions.quesText: A queue data structure follows the First-In First-Out (FIFO) principle.
questions.explanation: True. In a queue, elements are inserted at the rear (enqueue) and removed from the front (dequeue), maintaining FIFO ordering.

questions.quesText: What is the minimum number of nodes in a complete binary tree of depth d (root at depth 0)?
questions.explanation: A complete binary tree of depth d has all levels completely filled up to d-1 (total 2^d - 1 nodes) plus at least 1 node at depth d, giving at least 2^d nodes.

questions.quesText: In a singly linked list, the time complexity to insert a new node at the head is ____.
questions.explanation: Inserting at the head of a singly linked list requires only updating the new node's next pointer and the head pointer, taking constant O(1) time.

questions.quesText: In an undirected graph with V vertices, the maximum number of edges possible without self-loops or multi-edges is V*(V-1).
questions.explanation: False. For an undirected graph without self-loops, each edge connects two distinct vertices, so the maximum number of edges is V*(V-1)/2.

questions.quesText: In C programming, which format specifier is used with printf to output a floating-point number in exponential (scientific) notation?
questions.explanation: %e (or %E) formats a floating-point value in scientific notation (e.g., 1.234000e+02).

questions.quesText: In C programming, an uninitialized variable declared with the 'static' storage class is automatically initialized to ____.
questions.explanation: Variables with static storage duration are allocated in the BSS segment and initialized to zero by default before program execution begins.

questions.quesText: In C, the expression sizeof(char) is guaranteed by the ISO C standard to always evaluate to 1.
questions.explanation: True. The C standard defines the size of char as 1 by definition (sizeof(char) == 1).
